title: Why don't subtitles match dubbing?
summary: Tom Scott explains why subtitles often differ from dubbed dialogue, covering how translation, timing and reading speed shape each. It features translators and voice talent working in several languages.
why: Cited in subtitle threads for its explanation of why subtitles are condensed and adapted rather than literal.

quote.text: Tom Scott's video on subtitling talks about this historical practice and how it is different today
